newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.647 billion yuan from 1.388 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Non-banking financial institutions were the most active borrowers on the second-tier market on Tuesday, traders said.
They said today's gains were helped by recent comments by central bank officials that they wanted to see interest rates remain stable this year.
But the delay in a possible adjustment to bank reserve ratios makes the market's short-term direction uncertain, traders said.
"I think the interbank rates will move in a narrow range in the next few days on uncertainty over the bank reserve ratios," one trader said.
